name: Survey tile in Aquarius
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.2 degrees north of the ecliptic in Aquarius, imaged by SPHEREx 19 times in 6 visits over 67 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 38 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.8 days starting 2025-11-06, at wavelengths from 0.77 to 4.96 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
